means.idiom-jp: もう少しで…しそうになる
means.example-sentence: I came very close to uttering a few angry words, but barely got myself under control.
means.sentence-jp: 私はもうほんの少しで怒りの一言を発しそうになったが、なんとか自分を抑えた。

cloze.maskedText: I ____ a few angry words, but barely got myself under control.
cloze.answerBase: come close to doing / come near to doing

notes: come の代わりに be, get, go も使われる。
